dct_description_sm: This study is the major research body of the project 'IPY-Paleoenvironmental Change, Canadian Arctic' at Geological Survey Canada's commitment to IPY Canada and IPY international.  This study aims to sample multi sites for both surface snow and shallow firn cores for investigation of total mercury (THg) distribution and deposition rate trends in the Arctic region. Archives reconstructed with short firn cores will reveal atmospheric deposition history of mercury (Hg) in recent years to decades to pre-industrial revolution times at sites of Canadian High Arctic and Greenland.
dct_title_s: Temporal trend studies of the atmospheric Hg deposition with ice-core/snow in Canadian High Arctic and Greenland
